async def act(page):
    # Fill in the title for the new issue
    title_textbox = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Title (required)")
    await title_textbox.fill("Request: Add support for MT theme editor in a11y-syntax-highlighting")
    
    # Fill in the description for the new issue
    description_textbox = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Description")
    await description_textbox.fill("Please add support for the MT theme editor to enhance accessibility features in a11y-syntax-highlighting. This will allow users to customize themes more effectively while maintaining accessibility standards.")
    
    # Click the 'Issue' button to submit the new issue
    submit_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Issue")
    await submit_button.click()
    
    # Wait for the page to load after submission
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
